name: How are plumbing and electrical lines handled during cabinet removal?

mainEntity.name: How are plumbing and electrical lines handled during cabinet removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cabinet removal involves hidden electrical wiring, gas lines, and plumbing feeds for disposals, dishwashers, and under-cabinet lighting. Prying cabinets without proper trade prep risks punctured pipes or severed wires. As a general contractor serving Aurora, Centennial, and Denver, Abraham Becerra coordinates licensed sub-trades to cap and safely isolate plumbing and electrical connections before work begins. Doing so keeps the job site safe, code-compliant, and ready for your new kitchen configuration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plumbing and power connections are shut off and safely capped before removal to avoid accidental leaks, shorts, or damage to hidden lines.
